reasoning: CHANGED from None to Partial. The previous pass reached Partial but rested it on the STACK paper's own sentence that 'Anthropic and OpenAI acknowledged the responses we elicited were harmful and deployed mitigations' - the evaluator's account, which is inadmissible as Channel A evidence, and the pass flagged this for adjudication. Re-reading the GPT-5 system card in full resolves it with a company primary document instead. The previous pass reported that the card contains no reference to FAR.AI; it contains three, in a named Far.AI subsection of 5.3.3.4 'Third party red teaming' - and FAR.AI is the lead author organisation of STACK, with UK AISI the funder and co-author. Section 5.3.3.5 then states in OpenAI's own words that the UK AISI Safeguards team broke gpt-5-thinking's safeguard stack and that one jailbreak evading all layers 'is being patched'. That is OpenAI naming this finding's evaluator, this finding's model, and this finding's substance - working vulnerabilities in the production GPT-5 safeguard pipeline - and stating a remediation, in a document published 2025-08-13, after the 2025-07-18 finding date. Hence Explicit attribution. Level is Partial, not Substantive, on OpenAI's own hedging: the patch is in progress rather than complete ('is being patched'), the FAR.AI subsection says only 'We are actioning on some of these system vulnerabilities and will be strengthening the system post deployment', and it defers the rest to a residual-risk section. That matches STACK's own description of mitigations patching 'some of' the vulnerabilities, and STACK further records a gap OpenAI's asynchronous moderation does not close - the model still returns one potentially dangerous answer before flagging. Stated caveat: OpenAI never names the STACK paper or the specific image-embedded-text input-classifier bypass, and the card describes pre-launch red teaming whereas the finding is framed against production GPT-5, so the identification of the card's UK AISI/FAR.AI work with STACK Appendix K specifically is an inference from matching evaluator, model, safeguard-pipeline target, biological-misuse threat model and date window rather than from a stated link. Confidence medium for that reason. Independently, the 2025-09-12 CAISI/UK AISI post - which the previous pass could not open and has now been read in full via Wayback - describes the same collaboration granting UK AISI the ability 'to probe subcomponents of the system' and lists concrete deployed fixes, so the Partial does not rest on the system card alone.
